gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the same estimator defect: the half-width is incorrectly asserted to estimate the amplitude, whereas the interval and width facts support the midpoint and its epsilon error bound. It also gives the specific midpoint correction.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The proposition and algorithm use (a_u-a_l)/2 as a point estimate even though the interval containment and width bound justify (a_u+a_l)/2; the half-width does not control distance to a.

component_coverage.gold_component: The half-width is not an amplitude estimator; interval containment and width instead justify the midpoint estimator with error below epsilon.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly states that the half-width is not a point estimate, derives the midpoint estimator and epsilon bound from the interval facts, explains why the claimed half-width bound is false, and supplies the corrected formula.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 concerns incorrect fixed-point scaling and the resulting type in the multiplication lemma. It does not recognize the distinct register-width/permutation bookkeeping defect in which the multiplication circuit requires B qubits but the prepared state supplies an m-qubit zero register, so the circuit cannot be applied on the claimed Hilbert space.
